themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents actively performing research tasks, such as data gathering, synthesis, and analysis, with a focus on autonomous or semi-autonomous operation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and reviewing code, often integrated into IDEs or as standalone applications.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing various AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in their work, from data analysis to content generation.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Explores AI applications that aid in the creation, distribution, analysis, and optimization of surveys.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles examining the research, development, capabilities, and impacts of AI chatbots, including their accuracy, biases, and user interactions.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers AI applications used to analyze customer data, feedback, and behavior to derive actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Focuses on integrated platforms that leverage AI to streamline and enhance various aspects of research, from data management to analysis.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Discusses AI's role in qualitative research methods, such as analyzing text, audio, or video data for themes and sentiments.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is being integrated into the design process, from ideation to prototyping and user experience research.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers AI applications that automate software testing processes, including test case generation, execution, and defect detection.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
